# Carmel Valley Condos

> Carmel Valley condos and townhomes for sale in San Diego, CA 92130. Community guides, sold data, HOA details, and market reports by Sez Sezer, Keller Williams Realty (DRE #01988197) - 858-436-6585, sez@carmelvalley.com, 12750 High Bluff Drive, San Diego, CA 92130.

Every page listed below has a clean Markdown version at the same path (index.md). Structured community facts are in [communities.json](https://carmelvalleycondos.com/data/communities.json); the full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://carmelvalleycondos.com/llms-full.txt).

## Overview

- [Carmel Valley Condos & Townhomes for Sale](https://carmelvalleycondos.com/index.md): Home page: Carmel Valley (San Diego, CA 92130) condos and townhomes for sale, communities, and how to work with Sez Sezer.

## Communities

- [Arborlake Condos for Sale](https://carmelvalleycondos.com/arborlake-condos-for-sale/index.md): Arborlake: 190-unit lake-and-waterfall condo community (built 1986-1989) - prices by bedroom count, HOA, sold data, schools, FAQs.
- [Carmel Pointe Condos for Sale](https://carmelvalleycondos.com/carmel-pointe-condos-for-sale/index.md): Carmel Pointe: 200-unit condo community (built 2001-2002) with underground garage parking and a utility-inclusive HOA - prices by bedroom count, HOA, sold data, schools, FAQs.
- [Camino Villas Condos for Sale](https://carmelvalleycondos.com/camino-villas-condos-for-sale/index.md): Camino Villas: established central Carmel Valley condo community with a community pool - overview, listings, FAQs.
